resources.string: Android grants these by hand. Pinehold only asks for what your settings actually use.
What is needed
Device Owner

Of %1$d permissions Pinehold can use, your settings need these.
· not needed by your current settings
See which app is in front
Called Usage access in Settings. It is how blocking, limits and the time breakdown work at all.
Read the screen
Called Accessibility. Only ever reads text, so the keyword, Shorts, Reels and WhatsApp guards can recognise a surface. It never types or taps.
Hold back notifications
Lets the shield dismiss alerts from blocked apps. Always-allowed apps are never touched.
Step in when a blocked app opens
Called Display over other apps in Settings. Without it, Android stops Pinehold from stepping in once it has been in the background for a minute. Find Pinehold in the list and switch it on.
Let Pinehold step in
Without Display over other apps, blocked apps can open once Pinehold is in the background.
Notifications
Shows what is running, and warns you if the content guard is switched off mid-session. Nothing else.
Run without battery limits
Stops Android putting the guard to sleep in the middle of a long session.
Location
Only used by place rules, and only as a last known fix. Never a continuous stream.
Device admin
The first half of the Device Owner setup that kiosk mode needs.
Kiosk mode needs device admin.
This is the demo

Every screen, rule, task and setting here is the real app. What is missing is the enforcement: nothing is ever hidden, suspended, intercepted or closed, no notification is ever dismissed, and this build cannot be made Device Owner even over ADB. Set it up exactly as you mean to for real — the full version is what starts holding the line.
What the full version adds
Device Owner is active
Device Owner is not set
Kiosk sessions can hold, Safe Mode can be closed, and blocked apps can be suspended at the system level.
Without it, kiosk mode cannot really hold: the launcher stays reachable and Safe Mode starts the phone with Pinehold inert. It is set from a computer over ADB.
